pictures.inspected: Inspected southeast long facade: two upper windows to either side of central large round-headed glazing, shallow central risalit with triangular pediment, small balcony with open lattice and supported brackets; white quoin bands, green hip roof and two pale chimney stacks. Bushes conceal some lower doorway/treads.

pictures.inspected: Inspected northeast/back oblique: blind rectangular upper side panels, low green-roofed porch with posts and treads, white corner bands, black downpipe; long rear face has central pediment/arched upper glazing and a raised masonry approach. Conifers obscure the lower and far portions; detailed hidden inventory is approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete connected Kuzminsky House exterior at Yasnaya Polyana: mapped compact white two-storey block, green standing-seam hip roof and two pale capped chimney stacks. Central shallow risalits and triangular pediments, tall arched upper glazing, supported front balcony with open lattice proxies and brackets, recessed lower front entrance with closed treads/masonry stair sides, and northeast side porch with a low green roof, posts, recessed door and treads. Long rear elevation and blind side panels follow ordinary pictures with approximate hidden bay inventory. No copied texts, plaques, furnishings, artworks or photograph pixels.
